Countryside Cycling

Beyond the Old Town, By Bike

Rice fields, river villages and a slower side of Hội An — pedal through it with a local guide.

800,000₫ / guest (≈ €27)

Exact route and stops may vary slightly depending on your hotel pickup — message us for the latest details.

The Journey

Five stops along the way

01
Out of the Old Town, Onto Two Wheels

Flat, easy roads for about 12–15km (exact distance depends on your hotel), winding through rice paddies, river villages — and the odd herd of cattle crossing your path.

Included in the tour
02
Lantern-Making Workshop

Sit down with local artisans and make your own silk lantern from scratch — yours to take home as a one-of-a-kind souvenir.

Hands-on experience
03
Traditional Rice Wine Tasting

Step into a local home distillery to see (and taste) how Hội An's rice wine is made the old-fashioned way, straight from the still.

04
Say Hello to the Locals

Feed a flock of friendly ducks at golden hour at Duck Stop, and along the way you might spot — and snap photos with — water buffalo grazing the rice fields or a herd of cows crossing the road (photo ops only — we don't offer animal riding for guests).

05
Coconut Basket Boat

Finish the ride with a traditional round basket boat, paddled through a swaying coconut palm forest.

The perfect way to end the ride
